weapon.d: At start of combat, if foe's HP ≥ 75%, grants Atk/Spd+5 to unit and neutralizes unit's penalties to Atk/Spd during combat.

assist.d:

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+2 to unit for 1 turn.
